alkylation_reagent.evidence: After incubation, the eluate was removed, reduced with DTT, alkylated with iodoacetamide, and then run a ~6 mm into a 4–12% Bis-Tris NuPAGE gel (1 mm, 12-well; Thermo Fisher Scientific #NP0322BOX).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin working solution (~40 μl at 12.5 ng/μl in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate) was added to the gel pieces on ice, which were allowed to swell for 45 min.

enrichment_method.evidence: In IP experiments, extracts were combined with 10 μl of magnetic affinity medium (Thermo Fisher Scientific #14301) coupled to anti-RING1B antibodies (MBL, see Supplementary Data 6).

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Mass spectra were recorded on a QExactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

labeling.evidence: quantification: MS1 intensity based label-free quantification method

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Mass spectra were recorded on a QExactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

reduction_reagent.evidence: After incubation, the eluate was removed, reduced with DTT, alkylated with iodoacetamide, and then run a ~6 mm into a 4–12% Bis-Tris NuPAGE gel (1 mm, 12-well; Thermo Fisher Scientific #NP0322BOX).
